subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the lower levels of The Chasm
Go to the lower levels of The Chasm

10190201.text: #Oh? {NICKNAME} and Paimon? I didn't expect to see you two here.

10190202.text: Yanfei? Shouldn't you be at work in Liyue Harbor? What are you doing out in the middle of nowhere?

10190203.text: Well, to be perfectly honest, this case is a little out of the ordinary... In fact, this is the first time I've ever witnessed the bottom of The Chasm.

10190204.text: Oh, but before I forget! Could you do me a favor, please? If anyone happens to ask about me or my present whereabouts, just tell them you haven't seen me!

10190205.text: Huh? What are you talking about?

10190208.text: No, no, it's not like that. Look, it's quite a long story.

10190209.text: So if you could, please just cover for me. I'll see you later.

10190210.text: Hey! And there she goes... Huh, what in Teyvat was that all about? Paimon's starting to feel nervous all of a sudden...

10190211.text: Do you think she did something illegal and now she's gone into hiding here? *gasp* Or maybe something super scary happened...

10190212.text: Doubt it, Yanfei is a legal adviser, after all.

10190213.text: Don't be so naive! The world is complicated these days, you know. We should be prepared for the worst, if something really did happen, we might find ourselves becoming her accomplices!

10190214.text: Oh, what a dilemma... Should we really cover for her...?

10190215.text: Paimon, you are the one that's both naive and complicated...

10190216.text: Hey! You over there! Yeah, you!

10190218.text: But that voice sounds pretty familiar...

10190219.text: Haha, it's you two. So uh, what are you two doing in a place like this, huh? Wait, don't tell me... you're on vacation!

10190220.text: It's the one and oni Itto.

10190221.text: I must say, you two are lookin' pretty good, things been going your way lately? 'Cause I have been doing amazing.

10190222.text: Uh, Itto, who's that behind you?

10190223.text: Hey there, I'm with the Arataki Gang, Kuki Shinobu. Nice to meet you!

10190224.text: Ahahaha, right, I almost forgot she was back there. Let me introduce you to Shinobu, the pride and joy of the Arataki Gang!

10190225.text: Oh! Another member of Itto's gang!

10190226.text: Lemme tell ya, she's one of Hanamizaka's best and brightest, so of course she's in the gang. Shinobu takes care of practically everything in the Arataki Gang. She can protect you guys, too, you know.

10190227.text: #A friend of the boss is a friend of mine. You must be {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

10190228.text: Yep yep! Nice to meet you too, Shinobu!

10190230.text: The pleasure is mine. I have a feeling that we'll be working together soon enough.

10190231.text: So, uh, Itto, if she's the one that takes care of everything in the gang, then doesn't that kinda make her the gang's real boss?

10190232.text: Pff, are you kidding!? Of course I'm the boss. To the four corners of Teyvat, there is only one boss of Hanamizaka's legendary Arataki Gang. Me!

10190233.text: Hmm, okay Paimon gets the dynamic now. A useless boss with an ultra-capable subordinate...

10190234.text: Hey, you...! Ugh, you know what, forget it. The average person couldn't possibly understand the dynamics of the Arataki Gang. As the leader, I can't let myself stoop down to your level.

10190235.text: Anywayyy, have you seen a pink-haired legal... uh, mage lady? Wears a goofy hat, knows everything, kinda short.

10190237.text: Her name's Yanfei, she's a legal adviser from Liyue. I thought perhaps you two would know her.

10190238.text: Oh, no... we haven't seen her! We don't know this person at all! Hehe...

10190302.text: Hey Yanfei, we've sent away the people that were following you.

10190303.text: Oh, good, thanks a lot. The guy with the weird outfit seemed super outgoing. Normally, I don't mind making friends, but I've got work to do today.

10190304.text: Oh? So what kind of work are you doing in a place like this? Don't tell Paimon you're thinking about becoming an adventurer, too!

10190305.text: Well, as a legal adviser, sometimes I also have to travel in person. I came to The Chasm to deal with a will.

10190307.text: That's right. I found a will inside an old book, I'm guessing it was left by someone of great importance. It appears he lost a magical device and wished to retrieve it.

10190308.text: Paimon didn't know legal advisers have to deal with that kind of thing. What a job...

10190309.text: Will execution is also part of my work as a legal adviser. Of course, cases like this are quite rare. The Chasm is not the kind of place you can just waltz into whenever you want.

10190310.text: Oh? So, you do know what kind of place this is...

10190312.text: Ah, I thought I might find you here.

10190313.text: Whatever case you're working on in The Chasm, I'm sure Liyue's top legal consultant can handle it without my input.

10190314.text: Huh, that's funny — I thought we'd established that my legal opinion doesn't count for anything when Yelan's around?

10190316.text: This is Yelan. Liyue's uh... Well, let's just say she works in the Ministry of Civil Affairs. I can at least say that much, right? Anyway, she's a friend of mine.

10190317.text: Sure. Coincidentally, I have something to do here as well. Seems chance has brought us all together.

10190318.text: You may not know me, Traveler and Paimon, but I've certainly heard about you.

10190319.text: Oh really? I guess I do have many friends in Liyue...

10190320.text: You're all here on business, and it's my job to monitor The Chasm. According to regulations, I should accompany you.

10190321.text: But as it turns out, I have other things that require my attention. I'm afraid I can't join you this time. You may go about your business, just try to not make a ruckus.

10190322.text: Aww, that's most unfortunate, I was about to ask for your assistance.

10190323.text: Could you spare a little time to help me take care of this will... for old times' sake?

10190324.text: Hmm, I dunno... depends what's in it for me...

10190325.text: Fair enough, I suppose even a guide needs to get paid. It just so happens that Madame Ping gave me some nice tea. I'll treat you to a cup, if you agree.

10190326.text: Hehe, why don't you tell me a little more about how you got here first? Then I'll...

10190328.text: Uh... Itto? What is he doing back here!?

10190329.text: #I know what you two did... You really tried to throw me off, didn't you? Hmph, and I thought we were buds, {NICKNAME}!

10190330.text: Well, they're also my friends, so...

10190333.text: Sorry, this area is part of The Chasm. It's closed to the general public.

10190334.text: Are you kidding me? I don't see any warning signs or fences, what gives you the right to keep me out?

10190335.text: Kid, where there's real danger, you'll never see a warning sign.

10190336.text: Uh, Paimon never knew this place was so important.

10190337.text: It really is an unusual place...

10190338.text: It's true, this is not a place you can just go in and out of as you wish. That's also why I didn't want anyone to follow me. Unfortunately, you didn't listen...

10190339.text: The Traveler has done a lot for Liyue in the past, and Yanfei is a renowned legal consultant in Liyue, so I can trust their intentions. As for you two...

10190340.text: Hey, what's that supposed to mean!? You trying to say I'm not famous enough and my intentions are no good?

10190341.text: I don't know your background, so I can't give you free passage here. Besides, Yanfei doesn't seem to need your help, does she?

10190342.text: Hah! How would you know what Yanfei needs? What, are you two joined at the hip or something?

10190343.text: Right... Anyway, I don't need to be a mind-reader to see that...? In any case, as a visitor from Inazuma, I'd suggest you defer to a local when in doubt. Stick to the local rules and keep yourself out of trouble.

10190345.text: Please, try not to be impulsive. She is right, you know.

10190346.text: Uh-oh, things are starting to get a little heated here...

10190347.text: Not good... He really shouldn't start butting heads with Yelan.

10190348.text: It's true that we don't know anything about the unique conditions of this place, so we'll heed your advice and leave immediately. But if this really is a dangerous area, seriously, you should put up a sign.

10190349.text: Thanks for the suggestion, I'll consider it.

10190350.text: Oh yeah? And what if we don't leave? Hmm?

10190352.text: Then I'm afraid things might get... unpleasant.

10190353.text: Is that so? You really think you can take the two of us? Gotta admit, I like your optimism.

10190354.text: Although you're friends with the Traveler and Yanfei, I'd still suggest you heed my warning.

10190355.text: Haha... thanks for that, but too bad I'm not buyin' it! If you're so strong, then why don't you show me what you got!

10190356.text: Hold on, Boss. There's no need to start a fight here!

10190357.text: Oh, no, I'm going in whether she likes it or not.

10190358.text: Heh... You think I was joking around, huh?

10190359.text: Oh no, these two are about to go at it!

10190360.text: Please wait a minute, you two. This whole thing started because of me. Why don't you save me the embarrassment and just... huh?

10190363.text: Hey stop trying to change the subject! I'm gonna... huh?

10190405.text: Oww... putting my books under me to break the fall didn't help at all.

10190408.text: Ugh, gonna feel that in the morning... Hey, Shinobu, Traveler... and my savior! Is everyone okay?

10190409.text: *sigh* Well, this is an unfortunate turn of events.

10190410.text: Hey, so uh, how far down did we fall?

10190412.text: It seems the ground collapsed during our little confrontation up there. Perhaps because we triggered the elemental forces...

10190413.text: Well, don't look at me. If you weren't so rude, maybe I wouldn't have gotten mad. Who can put up with that kind of 'tude?

10190414.text: It's my duty to stop intruders from breaking into important places. If telling the truth sounds rude, then I'm afraid you're just a little too fragile.

10190415.text: Hey! Life's too short to give in all the time!

10190416.text: Boss, I'm afraid you're not going to win this argument. I suggest we stop provoking her.

10190417.text: Hey, whose side are you on here?

10190418.text: I'm simply pointing out the facts. I understand how you feel, but you're making my life difficult by starting random fights with everyone.

10190419.text: Heh, looks like Itto can't argue against either Yelan or Shinobu... He's in a real tough spot now...

10190420.text: So Itto and Shinobu are kinda like you and me.

10190421.text: Huh? Hey! What do you mean? Don't you dare compare Paimon to Itto!

10190422.text: Whoa, whoa! What do YOU mean? You lookin' for a fight too?

10190423.text: P—Paimon was just saying how it is... Everyone knows you're a bit of an idiot.

10190424.text: You calling me an idiot!? Oh yeah, well you're a puny little flying Lavender Melon. Hah!

10190425.text: Flying Lavender Melon? Ohhh that's it, Paimon's mad! Time to give you an ugly nickname... Uh, Bull-Chucker! Hmph, you better mind your manners, Bull-Chucker.

10190426.text: We seem to be a long way down from where we fell. It's impossible to see what's going on up above.

10190427.text: It's unlikely we'll be able to climb back up that far. We'll need to find another way.

10190428.text: I'm sorry to interrupt your lovely little chat here, but I think there's something you may need to know.

10190429.text: The Chasm is regarded as a mysterious area in Liyue. It was sealed off for years due to a mining accident. Whatever goes on down here, I suggest you remember this: You didn't see anything, you didn't hear anything, and you're not gonna ask any questions. Save you from getting caught up in things you shouldn't know about.

10190430.text: I won't treat you as hostiles, and in exchange, I hope you won't make things difficult when it comes to keeping secrets. I'll do what I can to find a way out.

10190431.text: Huh? Where does she think she's going?

10190432.text: Like she said, to search for an exit. Chances are that Yelan is the best among us at survival and handling emergencies, we should just let her go.

10190433.text: I'm afraid I must apologize... I don't typically disclose details of a client's will to third parties, which is why I couldn't tell you the truth... I'm sorry.

10190434.text: I came to The Chasm in search of the Fantastic Compass, which is mentioned in the will. Many years ago, my client gave this magical device to someone ambitious, hoping that it'd be handy in times of need.

10190435.text: According to an eye-witness account, the person who received the device took it into The Chasm and has been missing ever since.

10190436.text: Throughout history, many wars have been fought in the vicinity of The Chasm. Even if that person died in one of the wars, I still wish to do my utmost and find the device, and fulfill the client's wish.

10190437.text: Yelan's words of caution were not unwarranted. There are dangers lurking in The Chasm... I'm sure you've all realized that by now. Given that we're all caught in this mess, let's try to find a way out together.

10190438.text: Whatever you say, my savior... I'll do whatever you ask. From now on, we're a team, all of us. And as for that big jerk... Well, hmph, I guess that includes her, too.

10190439.text: You said Yelan works for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, huh? Paimon could tell she's tougher than most, but wow, her job sounds demanding.

10190440.text: Well, that's what she tells outsiders... I can't disclose too much about her identity, but I'd say she's the only person who can handle this type of work.

10190441.text: What kind of lame job would have someone go out to the middle of nowhere?

10190444.text: Hey, what's with the face? Did Paimon say something wrong? That's literally what the two of us do, isn't it?

10190445.text: I'm the adventurer, Paimon. Not you.

10190446.text: Ugh, you're so stingy these days... Just let Paimon be an adventurer by association, okay?

10190447.text: #Yeah, she's got a point, {NICKNAME}, you're Paimon's boss. Take it from me, as a great leader, you should learn to be a little more generous... You know, let your sidekick share some of the glory.

10190448.text: Ugh, you really don't understand anything about us!

10190449.text: Paimon, don't take him too seriously. He's just joking.

10190450.text: Hmph, for the sake of Shinobu... Fine.

10190451.text: Hmph, I'm the boss, so I'll let it slide.

10190453.text: Perhaps this was another sealed location, but an undocumented one... What could be in here?

10190454.text: I've got some food and water on me. If anyone needs some, just let me know.

10190455.text: Great! You know, Bull-Chucker, you may not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but your subordinate here seems super capable and reliable!

10190456.text: Hehe, I know, isn't she the best... Hey! I am too a sharp tool!

10190457.text: There seems to be an entrance up ahead with a path inside.

10190458.text: Wonder where it leads to... Well, let's go take a look.

10190501.text: Who woulda guessed we'd find a Domain entrance in a place like this...

10190502.text: If there's a way in, then there's a way out. Let's go and take a look.

10190503.text: The rocks here seem to be old Liyue Mountain Rocks, they're similar to what I've seen in books. This domain must have existed for quite some time now.

10190509.text: Conqueror of Demons? What are you doing here?

10190511.text: Oh, I came down from above. I heard a noise, so I followed it here.

10190512.text: So you're not here by accident. Wanna team up?

10190513.text: No, I have something else to do.

10190516.text: You shouldn't be here. I would urge you to go back as soon as possible.

10190517.text: Well, that's Xiao for ya... Shows up without warning and disappears without a trace.

10190518.text: Heh, that guy looked pretty tough, maybe almost as tough as me. Seems like a solid dude.

10190519.text: Seriously, Bull-Chucker, where do you get your confidence from...?

10190520.text: Should we really be letting him go off on his own?

10190521.text: Oh, he wouldn't listen, no matter how much you tried to talk him out of it... He is super tough, though, so don't worry about him.

10190522.text: Everyone, keep your eyes and ears peeled from here on out. We don't know what lies ahead, so we have to be ready for anything.

10190523.text: Oh, look, I'm happy to say we're all on the same team and everything, but... could you cut the little speeches and the whole follow-the-leader act? I, for one, think I should be able to look after myself...

10190526.text: Besides, Yelan is just looking out for everyone. You know, Bull-Chucker, you're a guest here, so maybe try to get along with everyone.

10190527.text: Hah! Please! You're not a local either, Flying Lavender Melon, so stop trying to sound like one!

10199904.text: Whoa... Well, this place is just as creepy as Paimon remembers it. If it wasn't for our little investigation, Paimon wouldn't ever come anywhere near this place.

10199905.text: Huh? Hey look, there's someone over there!
